items.summary: Lace's questionnaire says she would support expanding Bridge to Success so every interested SFUSD senior can take part.
items.title: Expand Bridge to Success to every interested SFUSD senior

citations.quote: As a trustee, I would support expanding Bridge to Success so that every interested SFUSD senior can participate.

items.title: Restore credit recovery at SFUSD high schools

citations.quote: As trustee, I would support restoring site-based credit recovery at SFUSD high schools.

items.summary: Lace's questionnaire says she would ask the Chancellor to evaluate demand and costs, then support a plan to launch and expand financially responsible CTE programs.
items.title: Launch and expand career technical education programs

citations.quote: I would then support an implementation plan to launch and expand CTE programs that are financially responsible.
